description: Implementation of the Technical Cooperation Project to enhance the dairy production in the Dry Zone
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-18 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A Technical Cooperation Project to enhance dairy production in the dry zone is planned to be implemented for a period of 03 years under a financial grant of Rs. 300 million from the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA). Through the said project, it is expected to achieve the objectives of designing  training and educational programmes, introducing appropriate techniques, strengthening fodder production and supply, improving hygienic milk production and usage, targeting dairy farming entrepreneurs producing 20 to 100 litres of milk per day in the Northern, Eastern, North Central and North Western provinces. Under the project, 02 Districts will be selected from each of the 04 relevant Provinces, and 03 Veterinary Ranges within those Districts will be selected, and it has been planned to establish 24 model farms in those 04 Provinces, with 03 model farms in each of those Veterinary Range.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation to implement the Technical Cooperation Project for the Development of Dairy Production in the Dry Zone as proposed, was approved by the Cabinet.
